answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the anchor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the timber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the pearl of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
